body:
# What is BlockCraft?
**BlockCraft** is a Europe Minecraft server that focuses on clean, competitive duels designed for 1.20.6+. Right now, you can jump into Classic 1v1 duels on 2 maps - Default and Green Castle. Test your skills against other players. More duel gamemodes and maps are coming soon!

# What Minecraft versions does BlockCraft support?
BlockCraft currently supports versions 1.20.6 up to the latest version. Sometimes it may take longer for an update. See [status](https://pvp-arena.net/status) for more info.

# How do I join the server?
You can join the server with this IP: play.blockcraftpvp.net
